content.text: Casino Santander online accepts the methods that UK players already use day to day, and it keeps credit cards off the list in line with the national ban on card-funded gambling.
Card, e-wallet and open-banking deposits all clear instantly, while withdrawals leave only after you finish identity checks.

items: **Visa / Mastercard debit**: deposit £10-£5,000, withdraw £20-£5,000, paid in 1-3 working days.
**PayPal**: deposit and withdraw £10-£5,000, settled within 24 hours.
**Skrill**: deposit and withdraw £10-£8,000, settled within 24 hours.
**Neteller**: deposit and withdraw £10-£8,000, settled within 24 hours.
**Trustly / Pay by Bank**: deposit £10-£10,000, withdraw £20-£10,000, settled within 24 hours.
**Bank transfer**: deposit £20-£20,000, withdraw £50-£20,000, paid in 2-5 working days.

content.text: Set Santander UK as your primary method, fund your first two deposits through it, and the account will upgrade to the Priority Status.

items: **Wider limits**: deposit and withdraw up to £30,000 per transaction, well clear of the usual bank-transfer ceiling.
**Faster turnaround**: withdrawals clear within an hour rather than the standard 2-5 working days, and a separate live-chat queue handles your requests.
**Reload credit**: every deposit adds a 25% bonus up to £200, with x35 wagering, kept apart from your weekly cashback so it never touches your rate or rank.
